## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.04.2026 - 25.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bluesdude55_, 20.08.2026, 1/5: "Poor and getting worse on Android...Sign in / Login issues everytime. Wasting too much time before being able to open app & start activity. No default setting retention. Auto Pause & type of activity setting should be set/forget similar to the Audio stat choice that remain checked or enabled. Actively looking for new app that works on the first launch. Purchase Information incorrect shows that I have over 400 days left on my subscription but using Free App Go version. don't recommend."
            2. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, 08.04.2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats asics."
            3. _Andre Brink_, 25.08.2026, 3/5: "usually good, but today it recorded only my time, no distance no pace, no commentary. so the app was running, my gps was on and still on after the run and showed 3 green bars before I started. And then they chose today to ask me to rate the app...... Another run, only time recorded. My app is broken."
<!--/ir-theme-->
